visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide exterior shot of a grey Ineos Grenadier SUV attempting to climb a steep, sandy incline on an off-road course. The vehicle is angled upward, with its rear facing the camera, positioned against a backdrop of green hills and a bright blue sky. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of the vehicle, showing a split-screen perspective. On the left, the camera captures the driver, a man wearing sunglasses and a grey shirt, steering the vehicle. On the right, an external side view shows the car's wheels churning through the dirt. The passenger, a man wearing a black flat cap and a dark t-shirt with visible arm tattoos, is seen gesturing toward the dashboard. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the overhead console of the car, which features a variety of toggle switches and buttons reminiscent of an aircraft cockpit. The passenger's hand reaches up to press a specific button labeled with differential lock icons. (4) The split-screen returns, showing the driver carefully navigating a particularly steep and uneven section of the dirt track. The car tilts significantly to one side as it surmounts a ridge. (5) The final phase shows the vehicle successfully reaching the top of the incline and beginning a controlled descent. The driver and passenger look toward the camera, both appearing satisfied, with the interior dashboard screen displaying technical off-roading data and maps.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the professional-grade off-road capabilities of the Ineos Grenadier SUV. By placing the vehicle in a high-stakes, nearly precarious situation ('almost flipping over') and showing how its technical features (like the differential lock) allow it to recover easily, the video builds consumer trust and highlights the car's rugged design and aircraft-inspired cockpit controls.
